title: Can I consult with the Occupational Therapist about my child's progress outside of scheduled sessions?
metaTitle: Consultation Outside Therapy Sessions - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Pinnacle Blooms Network encourages parents to consult with our Occupational Therapists about their child's progress outside of scheduled sessions.
html: Absolutely! At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we believe that open communication between parents and therapists is crucial for the child's progress. While the best time to discuss your child's progress might be during scheduled sessions, we understand that you might have questions or concerns at other times. Feel free to schedule a separate meeting time with our therapists - we're here to provide support and answer all your queries.
